status: proposal (claude-a/progression, 25 Oct); every number is a placeholder until play-tests and Claude L's harness
name: Clack
identity: older broad heavy gunner; rocket launcher on the RIGHT shoulder, a separate pressure chamber under the tube, a two-rocket rack on the front LEFT of the belt, a folding loader frame flat on the back
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/clack.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Hot Loader
techniques.effect: The vent's kick speeds the loading.

upgrade.name: Hot Loader II
upgrade.effect: A vent that hits two or more foes completes the reload.

techniques.name: Cluster Nose
techniques.effect: The blast scatters three small bomblets that pop a moment later.

upgrade.name: Cluster Nose II
upgrade.effect: Bomblets nudge small foes toward the blast's centre.

techniques.name: Planted Shield
techniques.effect: He plants the shield: he cannot walk, blocked shots stop draining the guard, and the next rocket's blast is larger.

upgrade.name: Planted Shield II
upgrade.effect: The planted shield covers his whole front half.
